statement: Scan Essentials loads point clouds (E57, LAS/LAZ, PLY, TZF, RWP), builds an RWP index and unloads them per session.

source.ref: Point cloud load and unload (RWP, TZF, E57, LAS/LAZ, PLY)

superiority: Streaming octree indexes with no conversion step.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Load 100M-point E57; first view within budget, count preserved.

statement: Manager controls opacity, point size, density and colorization (white, station color, intensity, elevation, true color, grey intensity).

source.ref: Point Cloud Manager: display (opacity, size, density, colorization)

notes: Acceptance sketch: Switch each colorization; pixel colors equal mapping.

statement: Shading modes and cloud views filter points by normal and view direction.

source.ref: Shading modes and cloud views (normal, ambient, see inside, outline)

notes: Acceptance sketch: See Inside hides points facing the camera.

statement: Blending options 0, 50, 75, 100 percent and conditional blending alter visibility near model geometry.

source.ref: Point cloud blending with model geometry

superiority: Depth-aware blending computed per pixel on the GPU rather than from fixed preset ratios.
notes: Acceptance sketch: For each of 4 preset ratios, composited pixel equals the mix formula within 1 LSB.

statement: Point Cloud Pick, SketchUp Pick and Disable Snapping modes prioritize inference against points or geometry.

source.ref: Point cloud snapping and pick modes

superiority: Plane, edge and corner fitting snaps computed from local neighborhoods in the cloud.
notes: Acceptance sketch: In each pick mode, a scripted hover returns the expected target (cloud point or model entity) per documented priority.

statement: Clipping boxes limit visible points, listed in the Manager, Entity Info and Outliner, activatable and renamable.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Box clip returns points inside only.

statement: Tools create guides from planes and edges detected in the point cloud.

source.ref: Guide creation tools from scan data

notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/scan-essentials-sketchup/modeling-tips-and-tricks Acceptance sketch: Guide on fitted plane within 5 mm.

statement: Texture Projection projects point cloud colors or imagery onto model faces.
superiority: Multi-image projection blends several photographs with seam-aware weighting.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Project a calibrated image onto a face; texel positions of 4 control marks match their scan locations within 2 pixels.

statement: Mesh Generation builds a polygon mesh from a point cloud region.
superiority: Poisson or ball-pivot reconstruction with LOD.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Mesh deviation from points below 5 mm RMS on fixture.

statement: Scenes control point cloud visibility per scene; 2026.2 adds a Point Clouds option in scene properties.

source.ref: Scene Manager for point clouds and Scene Properties visibility

notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/creating-scenes Acceptance sketch: Scene switch toggles visibility.

statement: Export can revert to original georeferenced coordinates.

source.ref: Revert to original georeferenced coordinate system on export

superiority: Round trip to the original CRS is lossless and verified by checksum of the coordinates.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Export, re-import and compare 100 control points to the original; maximum difference 1 mm.

statement: Point clouds appear in LayOut viewports.
superiority: Point clouds appear in viewports as vector-quality linework and image fill with controllable density.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Insert a viewport containing a point cloud; the viewport shows points with the scene settings applied.

source.ref: Sample point cloud data and tips

superiority: Bundled sample datasets drive the acceptance corpus so every workflow is testable offline.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/scan-essentials-sketchup/modeling-tips-and-tricks Acceptance sketch: Open the bundled sample cloud; point count and bounding box match the metadata exactly.

statement: Scan Space converts a phone scan to a model and organizes scanned spaces.
superiority: Conversion runs on-device and offline with a deviation report against the raw scan.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup-labs/converting-scanned-space-data Acceptance sketch: Convert a scanned room fixture; wall planes deviate from the reference by less than 2 cm RMS.

statement: Gaussian Splatting extension loads and manages splats from images or video.
superiority: Splat rendering within the native viewport.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/getting-started-gaussian-splats https://help.sketchup.com/en/managing-gaussian-splats Acceptance sketch: Splat renders; visibility management.
